src/main/index.ts: Electron entry: creates window, Engine and host, points SDK at Claude binary.
src/main/ipc.ts: Generic iae:invoke dispatcher to Engine and iae:event forwarder.
src/main/env.ts: Environment variable and settings access for main process.
src/main/engine/engine.ts: Engine class implementing IaeApi; orchestrates everything.
src/main/engine/lead.ts: Warm streaming lead session that converses and drives the map.
src/main/engine/lead-options.ts: Lean Agent SDK options for fast lead first-word latency.
src/main/engine/context.ts: Builds per-turn <context> block for lead messages.
src/main/engine/prompts.ts: System prompts for lead, crew, cartographer and sketcher.
src/main/engine/tools.ts: Lead's iae MCP tools: sketch_map, ask, decide, delegate etc.
src/main/engine/sdk.ts: Thin wrapper around Claude Agent SDK query().
src/main/engine/speech.ts: Shapes lead text output for speaking, handles silence.
src/main/engine/crew.ts: Runs builder/scout Claude Code jobs, queue and permissions.
src/main/engine/crew-tools.ts: Crew MCP tools: map_update and ask_architect.
src/main/engine/gate.ts: PreToolUse shell gate routing risky commands to user approval.
src/main/engine/activity.ts: Turns tool_use stream into agent steps and file activity.
src/main/engine/cartographer.ts: Read-only session that maps an existing codebase.
src/main/engine/sketcher.ts: Haiku session turning draft speech into ghost proposals.
src/main/engine/mapdiff.ts: Diffs maps to tell the lead what changed.
src/main/engine/agenda.ts: Open questions, decisions and blocking waiters.
src/main/engine/pulse.ts: Idle heartbeat that nudges the lead with backoff.
src/main/engine/workspace.ts: Project workspace paths and helpers for crew jobs.
src/main/project/store.ts: Persists .iae/ files, recent projects and settings.
src/main/project/files.ts: Gitignore-aware file scanner and chokidar watcher.
src/main/project/heuristic.ts: Instant heuristic map from folders and manifests.
src/shared/events.ts: EngineEvent union sent main to renderer.
src/shared/map.ts: ArchMap types and helpers like ownerOf.
src/shared/model.ts: Shared domain types: agents, agenda, settings, transcript.
src/renderer/src/App.tsx: Top-level app switching Home and map workspace.
src/renderer/src/bridge/index.ts: Picks real window.iae or mock bridge.
src/renderer/src/map/NodeCard.tsx: Renders a component card on the map.
src/renderer/src/map/Crew.tsx: Live builder/scout tokens on the map.
src/renderer/src/map/Questions.tsx: Agenda question cards placed on the map.
src/renderer/src/map/Permission.tsx: Approve/deny prompts for crew tool permissions.
src/renderer/src/conversation/Conversati: Hosts intent line, caption and transcript.
src/renderer/src/conversation/IntentLine: Text/voice input line for talking to the lead.
src/renderer/src/conversation/lexicon.ts: Instant local ghost autocomplete from words.
src/renderer/src/voice/controller.ts: Coordinates mic, VAD, STT and TTS turn-taking.
src/renderer/src/voice/sttWorker.ts: Web Worker running Whisper via transformers.js.
src/renderer/src/lens/Lens.tsx: File lens: code view, env editor, meaning.
src/renderer/src/avatar/Archie.tsx: Archie avatar animated by conversation state.
electron.vite.config.ts: Build config for main, preload and renderer.
electron-builder.yml: Packaging config for the macOS app.
scripts/smoke-engine.mjs: Smoke test running the engine headless.
examples/recipe-box/README.md: Sample monorepo used to demo cartography.
scripts/shoot-electron.mjs: This script uses Playwright to automate the real Electron desktop app, simulating user actions like creating or opening projects, speaking …
src/renderer/src/map/techLine.ts: Picks a node's technical name and stack to show on hover.
src/renderer/src/map/techLine.test.ts: Tests for the hover tech line: what shows, what fits, what's skipped.
